description.value: Pokey Okey is a locally founded Hawaiian poke bowl chain that opened its first location in central Richmond in 2018 before expanding to Kingsway and Downtown Vancouver. Each bowl is assembled to order using responsibly sourced fish and locally grown vegetables, with signature offerings like the Green Bowl and the lighter Skinny Bowl. For a cyclist passing through Richmond's No. 3 Road corridor, it offers quick, customizable, protein-rich meals with a pickup ordering option.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: rack at 8m; lockers (secure) at 38m; rack at 45m; rack at 60m; rack at 89m.
